identity.title: Add production birth-witness policy provisioning and invocation boundary

values.task_boundary: Implement only the production provisioning, invocation, emission, and focused proof missing from #5833.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: A non-test Runtime owner can provision trusted policy without exposing policy internals.
AC2: The production path builds and validates a witness packet before emitting its receipt.
AC3: An external integration test proves real production-path use and exact receipt emission.
AC4: Existing #5833 security, privacy, canonicalization, rejection, and non-authority behavior remains unchanged.
AC5: Focused tests and strict Clippy pass at the reviewed exact revision.
dependencies: Closed issue #5833 and merged PR agent-logic/agent-design-language#198
non_goals: Changing the witness algorithm or receipt schema
Broad Runtime orchestration or Birthday demo work
Granting birth, citizenship, governance, legal, or launch authority
